description: This file defines the ZoneInfo class for the Revive Adserver project, representing zone configuration data including properties like zone ID, publisher ID, zone name, type, dimensions, capping, comments, and chained zone ID. It includes methods for setting default values and retrieving field types.

classes.name: OA_Dll_ZoneInfo
classes.description: Class extending OA_Info, encapsulating information about ad zones with properties and methods for default setup and field type retrieval.

methods.name: setDefaultForAdd
methods.description: Sets default values for zone properties when adding a new zone.

methods.name: getFieldsTypes
methods.description: Returns an array mapping field names to their data types.
